profile.entry_point_hint: Multiple microservices: app/platform_orchestrator/src/main.py creates the FastAPI app for the orchestrator service, app/regulatory_agent/src/main.py creates the FastAPI app for the regulatory agent service. Additionally, app/common_auth is a shared library module (no server entry point).

gateway.name: RegisterRequest
gateway.description: Data transfer object for agent registration requests.

gateway.name: OrchestrationRequest
gateway.description: Data transfer object for orchestration requests from clients.

services.name: OrchestratorService
services.description: Orchestrates agent execution and handles request routing in the platform orchestrator service.

services.name: PromptValidationService
services.description: Validates user prompts before processing in the orchestration pipeline.

services.name: RegistrationService
services.description: Manages agent registration and discovery for the platform.

services.name: AgentFetcherService
services.description: Fetches agent metadata and configurations from external sources.

services.name: TableStorageService
services.description: Manages Azure Table Storage operations for persisting agent data.

services.name: RegulatoryAgentExecutor
services.description: Executes regulatory compliance agent with tool support for the regulatory agent service.

services.name: RegulatoryAgentService
services.description: Core service for regulatory compliance checking and agent operations.

services.name: BillingCodeService
services.description: Service for retrieving and managing billing code information and edits.

services.name: BillingCodeTool
services.description: Tool for agents to access billing code information and perform lookups.

services.name: CCIEditService
services.description: Service for handling CCI (Correct Coding Initiative) edits and validations.

services.name: CCIEditTool
services.description: Tool for agents to access and apply CCI edit rules.

services.name: MueEditService
services.description: Service for managing MUE (Medically Unlikely Edit) rules and edits.

services.name: MueEditTool
services.description: Tool for agents to access and apply MUE edit rules.

services.name: RegulatorySearchService
services.description: Service for searching regulatory documents and compliance information.

services.name: RegulatorySearchTool
services.description: Tool for agents to search regulatory databases and documentation.

services.name: DataPlatformClient
services.description: HTTP client for communicating with external data platform APIs.

services.name: ElixirApiClient
services.description: HTTP client for communicating with the Elixir API for billing code data.

services.name: LaunchDarklyService
services.description: Service for feature flag management using Launch Darkly.

services.name: AgentToolFactory
services.description: Factory for creating A2A agent tools with HTTP client support.

services.name: AzureAIClientFactory
services.description: Factory for creating Azure OpenAI chat clients with authentication.

services.name: TableStorageClientFactory
services.description: Factory for creating Azure Table Storage service clients.

services.name: CitationContext
services.description: Context class for managing citation strategy in agent responses.

services.name: CitationStrategy
services.description: Abstract base class for citation formatting strategies.

data.name: AgentRepository
data.description: Repository for managing agent persistence and discovery in storage.

data.name: AgentEntity
data.description: Domain model representing an agent with registration metadata.

data.name: FetchResult
data.description: DTO representing the result of fetching agent data from external sources.

data.name: RegistrationResult
data.description: DTO representing the result of agent registration.

data.name: ChatContentHistory
data.description: DTO for storing message history in orchestration requests.

data.name: OrchestrationResponse
data.description: DTO for responding with orchestrated agent results.

data.name: ToolCall
data.description: DTO representing a tool invocation by the agent.

data.name: AgentResponse
data.description: DTO for agent responses with citations and content.

data.name: Citation
data.description: DTO representing a source citation in agent responses.

data.name: SearchServiceResult
data.description: DTO for search results from regulatory document service.

data.name: BillingCodeResponse
data.description: Domain model for billing code lookup response data.

data.name: Category
data.description: Domain model for billing code categories.

data.name: CodeDetailsResponse
data.description: Domain model for detailed billing code information.

data.name: ItemDetail
data.description: Domain model for item details in billing code responses.

data.name: ReplacementCode
data.description: Domain model for replacement billing codes.

data.name: ApplicableModifier
data.description: Domain model for applicable modifiers on billing codes.

data.name: CCIEdit
data.description: Domain model for CCI edit rules.

data.name: CCIEditResponse
data.description: Domain model for CCI edit validation responses.

data.name: MueValue
data.description: Domain model for MUE edit value data.

data.name: MueApiResponse
data.description: Domain model for MUE API responses.

data.name: MueEditResult
data.description: Domain model for MUE edit validation results.

external_actors.name: Azure Table Storage
external_actors.description: Persistent data store for agent registration and configuration metadata.

external_actors.name: Azure OpenAI Service
external_actors.description: LLM service for generating agent responses and orchestrating conversations.

external_actors.name: Data Platform API
external_actors.description: External API for CCI and MUE edit rules and healthcare compliance data.

external_actors.name: Elixir API
external_actors.description: External API providing billing code information and healthcare coding standards.

external_actors.name: Azure Cognitive Search
external_actors.description: Vector search service for regulatory document retrieval and compliance information.

external_actors.name: Launch Darkly
external_actors.description: Feature flag management service for controlling regulatory agent behavior.
